title: The lifting lemma of Popescu's theorem
statement: Let $R$ be a Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], $\Lambda$ an $R$-algebra and $\pi\in R$ with $\mathrm{Ann}_R(\pi)=\mathrm{Ann}_R(\pi^2)$ and $\mathrm{Ann}_\Lambda(\pi)=\mathrm{Ann}_\Lambda(\pi^2)$ (annihilators of the elements $\pi$, $\pi^2$ in $R$ and of their images in $\Lambda$). Suppose given homomorphisms of $R$-algebras $R/\pi^2R\to\bar C\to\Lambda/\pi^2\Lambda$ with $\bar C$ of finite presentation over $R/\pi^2R$. Then there are an $R$-algebra $D$ and a homomorphism of $R$-algebras $D\to\Lambda$, together with a homomorphism of $R$-algebras $\bar C\to D/\pi D$ such that the diagram formed by $R/\pi^2R\to\bar C\to\Lambda/\pi^2\Lambda$, $R/\pi R\to D/\pi D\to\Lambda/\pi\Lambda$ (the second map induced by $D\to\Lambda$) and the vertical maps $R/\pi^2R\to R/\pi R$, $\bar C\to D/\pi D$, $\Lambda/\pi^2\Lambda\to\Lambda/\pi\Lambda$ commutes, with the following properties: (a) $D$ is of finite presentation over $R$; (b) $R\to D$ is smooth at every prime $\mathfrak q\subset D$ with $\pi\notin\mathfrak q$ (smooth at a prime as in [def-weil-pbc-singular-ideal]); (c) $R\to D$ is smooth at every prime $\mathfrak q\subset D$ with $\pi\in\mathfrak q$ whose image in $\operatorname{Spec}(D/\pi D)$ lies over (via $\bar C\to D/\pi D$) a prime of $\bar C$ at which $R/\pi^2R\to\bar C$ is smooth; (d) $\bar C/\pi\bar C\to D/\pi D$ is smooth at every prime of $D/\pi D$ lying over a prime of $\bar C$ at which $R/\pi^2R\to\bar C$ is smooth.
